{{Short description|American anthropologist}}
'''Per Hage''' (October 9, 1935 - July 25, 2004), was an American anthropologist known for his [[kinship]] studies with mathematician [[Frank Harary]]. They researched the connections between anthropology and mathematics.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Marck|first=Jeff|date=2006|title=In Memoriam, Per Hage, 1935-2004|journal=Oceanic Linguistics|volume=45|issue=2|pages=491–496|issn=0029-8115|jstor=4499974}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Jenkins|first=David|date=2008-07-01|title=Anthropology, Mathematics, Kinship: A Tribute to the Anthropologist Per Hage and His Work with the Mathematician Frank Harary|url=https://escholarship.org/uc/item/1hs7w49v|journal=UCLA: Human Complex Systems|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|date=2004-08-01|title=Paid Notice: Deaths HAGE, PER|language=en-US|work=The New York Times|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2004/08/01/classified/paid-notice-deaths-hage-per.html|access-date=2020-05-11|issn=0362-4331}}</ref>

==Books with Harary==
* ''Structural Models in Anthropology'' (1984) {{ISBN| 978-0521273114}}
* ''Island Networks: Communication, Kinship, and Classification Structures in Oceania'' (2007) {{ISBN| 978-0521033213}}
* ''Exchange in Oceania: A Graph Theoretic Analysis'' (1991)
